notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, managers![/h2]

With this update, you’ll have to cater to a whole new audience - children! The kids’ department is now open, so let’s see what’s inside! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/e31ee379ad6b22800de80e1c8addc5a472fc2949.png[/img]

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]

[h3]You can now sell clothes for children![/h3]

Our managers have been asking for this for a long time, so it’s finally time to expand the range of clothes that we sell to fit (ha-ha, get it?) a new audience. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/3db18d7017cace11491fdfbf7edf09f66e9b3d4e.gif[/img]

With this major update, our managers get access to 4 new brands that specialize in children’s clothing:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/59437b6755bb4ac4af4aa1bccb84cf8ee16a4adb.gif[/img]

And to 6 new appropriately-sized mannequins to showcase it: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/ce238c63449959bc9deead811b486297d8880632.png[/img]

[h2]Other Updates & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Items from previous seasons of the Clothing Pass can now be purchased with in-game money instead of Kiki Coins. 
[/list]

We can’t wait to see how you will adjust your beautiful stores to fit the new section and we hope you’ll enjoy the variety of clothes included in this update.

Speaking of your beautiful stores, have you seen the latest Clothing Store Simulator trailer made possible by our amazing community and their creative stores? 
[previewyoutube=s4PF19G0oBg;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

Have fun in the new update, managers, and we can’t wait to show you the next one we’re working on - it will be focused on making your experience in Clothing Store Simulator much smoother! 

Meanwhile, If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between.

notes.title: Online Orders Update / Clothing Store Simulator
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, managers![/h2]

We’re excited to finally open the doors of the Post Office that’s been teasing you every time you left your stores! So let’s get into the details of the update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/eceb2634c82b27d40915f8fe1e8ea51c2f776e14.png[/img]

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]

[h3]Online Orders are now in the game! [/h3]

When you update the game, you’ll see the ‘[i]Online Orders[/i]’ tab on your in-game computers after you reach [b]level 20[/b]. Press it to find a multitude of people too busy to go to your stores on foot but still want a fresh set of clothes! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8f176ab8ec21b55f34e3a3aae8d52a8f82998407.gif[/img]

Accept the orders that you want and start collecting clothes from your shopping area and the Warehouse!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8fdaf6279855032b1882a41b0606f4ef881441e1.gif[/img]

When an online order is active, press TAB to check what items you need to collect!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/4a68e0997055dc60e6380905e1d60caabd764bb2.gif[/img]

To send the online order, just bring all the required clothes to the Post Office and put them in the box! Done! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/48d10a9e46d4d841b8184a6f0f2f55991ef2a41c.gif[/img]

[h2]Changes & Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Font Import system added.[/b] You can now import your favorite fonts to put on your Special Designs. 
[*] [b]Cart Increased.[/b] You are now able to place 20 items in the order cart instead of 15.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

We hope that you like this update! We continue to work on the game to bring more gameplay elements, optimizations, and changes, so you’ll be hearing from us pretty soon about what’s coming to Clothing Store Simulator next!

Meanwhile, If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 

[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

See you next time!

notes.title: Clothing Pass | Store Manager Training #4
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, managers![/h1]

Welcome back to Store Manager Training. This time, we’re thrilled to introduce you to the Clothing Pass and an exciting new addition to your neighborhood – the Clothing Pass Market! This place, located just across the street from your clothing store, is designed to keep your inventory fresh and trendy daily.

[h2]Let’s dive in![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

[h2]Earn to Spend[/h2]
What’s the first question every successful manager asks themselves in the morning? “How do I spend all the cash I earned yesterday?” Well, look no further – Clothing Pass is your answer!

Purchase the Clothing Pass with your hard-earned in-game cash and unlock access to a multitude of unique rewards for the whole clothing season. This pass features a special daily leveling system that offers unique rewards and Kiki Coins, which you can spend across the street to elevate your store’s offerings.

A new reward opens every IRL day of the season! You can log in daily to grab them as soon as they're available or level up and collect them all at the end of the season! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/7af9585809c7ade55888f4b7ab83c44a646830b9.gif[/img]

[h2]Keep It Fresh[/h2]
Do you aspire to be a trendsetter in the world of clothing shops? With [b]Kiki Coins[/b], you gain access to the Clothing Pass Market, where new items are available every day. Yes, you heard that right – every single day!

Visit the Market across the street, where a friendly face awaits to show you their ever-changing selection. And it’s not just clothes – we’re talking about Store Decorations too. Use your Kiki Coins to keep your store brimming with unique and exclusive clothes and decorations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/21002ecdb7c506c3d3b22b8469c06965ff880cd1.gif[/img]

[h2]Level Up Your Game[/h2]
Don’t forget about the fantastic rewards you receive by leveling up your Clothing Pass.

How do you level it up, you ask? By being an outstanding manager and earning XP from happy customers every day you log into the game! The first Clothing Pass offers a plethora of Kiki Coins for you to spend, uniquely designed clothes, and access to customizable shoes. Sounds like a manager’s dream, doesn’t it? But it’s all true, I assure you.

The Clothing Pass will be constantly updated with new items, keeping it fresh for both aspiring managers and fashion gurus like yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/ce749d5cbc51178dd2ae6a40171227494e29448d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

[h3]That’s it for this training session, managers! Go enjoy your Clothing Pass and stay tuned for more news and updates![/h3]

If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 
[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

See you next time!

notes.title: Store Manager Training #3
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, managers![/h1]

Welcome back to Store Manager Training. In this edition, we will focus on becoming a true leader in your store and letting others do parts of your job for you. That’s what being a manager is all about! 

[h3]Manage now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

[h2][b]Let's get started![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

[h2]Let Them Sell[/h2]
Imagine you have a great idea for a Special Design that you can sell in your store. Or maybe you want to order new decorations. Your creativity is flowing, but you see a big line at the cashier’s desk! Now, you have to actually work and serve your customers—what a bummer! What if I told you that you don’t have to do that?

When you reach level 15, you can hire [i][b]Cashiers[/b][/i] to do this job. And that’s not all - the more cashier desks you buy, the more cashiers you can hire! Just look at them proudly and get back to your creative flows! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fa313a522a692840925deba51bf42414389d583e.gif[/img]

Oh wait...

[h2]Let Them Shelve[/h2]

You’re running out of clothes in the shopping area! Oh man, you must go to a Warehouse and restock everything yourself. But what if I told…. [i]Yeah, yeah, yeah, you know the drill[/i]. You can hire [i][b]Restockers[/b][/i]! 

The first [i][b]Restocker[/b][/i] becomes available when you reach level 20, and they will, what a surprise, restock the shopping floor with products from your Warehouse. Not only that, but they will also pick up clothes thrown on the floor by awful, rude customers or even by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/3da6743143ce7892d37e7cbc3fd696137d2f86a2.gif[/img]

[h2]Let Them Bring[/h2]
Oh no, the only thing left to do is to bring a new batch of clothes from the street! But you don’t want to leave your cozy store! So here’s a solution for you - [i][b]Warehouse Workers[/b][/i]! No need to leave the store anymore; you can focus on your passions while your busy NPC Workers are helping you out! 

The first [i][b]Warehouse Worker[/b][/i] becomes available when you reach level 25, and they will bring clothes from the street to your Warehouse! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/6014e71f14838d4e820f4559ef1fe235519b2d41.gif[/img]

[h2](Don’t) Let Them Rest[/h2]
But don’t forget—all of these workers that you hire are also human, and you need to treat them accordin[b]HAHAHAHA[/b]. Sorry, I couldn’t keep a straight face. They work for [i]YOU[/i], and they rest when you tell them to! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/f67009910dbaec3510da2d08e7a86147ea04e1e9.png[/img]
Just remember, long work without rest can affect performance, which can only mean one thing…

[h2]Let Them Go[/h2]
Look, you’re a business owner, you have to make tough decisions sometimes! If you feel your employees are not working efficiently because they don’t respect your store, or you just want to take a break from being a creative genius and get back to your roots - just dismiss them using your in-game computer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/47040497dbab2dad5dd64d93a3cfc6a441bf8597.gif[/img]

They’ll just disappear from your store, and you’ll be able to hire better workers in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

[h3]That’s it for this Training session, managers! Next time, we’ll discuss some cool and highly requested additions coming to the Clothing Store Simulator. [/h3]

If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 
[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

See you next time!

notes.title: Store Manager Training #2
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, aspiring managers![/h1]

Most of you are already honing your skills in [i]Clothing Store SImulator: Prologue[/i], so today, we wanted to prepare for some of the things that will come in the full version of [i]Clothing Store Simulator[/i]! 

[b]WARNING:[/b] If you read this far and didn’t play [i]Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue[/i] or wishlist the full version, you won’t have the required skills to fully grasp the contents of this training and unlock your full potential as a store manager!* 

[h3]Play now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937710/Clothing_Store_Simulator_Prologue/

[h3]Wishlist now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

[b]And now we're ready to start! [/b]

[i]*For legal reasons we must say this this statement is simply untrue,[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

[h2]Become Fashion[/h2]
Being a Clothing Store Manager is great, of course. That’s why we have these trainings! But what if you could not only sell someone else's clothes but… [b]DESIGN YOUR OWN???[/b] Oh yeah, we’re going to make fashion trendsetters out of you! Because every store manager is a multi-faceted being capable of many things! We’ll cover this feature fully in one of our future trainings, so now just get excited and take a look at this highlight: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/1e239f14beee95c62ce8840ea7337c22bf118aed.gif[/img]

[h2]Dressing from Head to Toe[/h2]

[h3]Take a look at these mannequins. What do you notice? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/849271d8cce258e04fc5b919393bee516dca8924.png[/img]

That’s right! Their head and feet are [i][b]COMPLETELY NAKED[/b][/i]. We want to dress our customers from head to toe, so you'll be able to do that in the full version of the game! Literally! Take a look at some of the hats and shoes that will be available in the game! Aren’t they nice? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fce92c75f453953d9554c095a8044f0875c3880e.gif[/img]

[h2]Finding Your Personal Touch[/h2]
When customers see your smiling face after entering your store, they know they’re in good hands. But what if they don’t enter and just look from the outside? That’s where further customization comes in! In Clothing Store Simulator, you’ll be able to name your shop and customize your floors and walls. We already know you are thinking of a thousand wholesome and light-hearted names for your stores!

[I](Just please, don’t put them in the comments!)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/225a134c110d08a947284c4e088529f1fb364d85.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8d95ccc3917fa47ab80da8bd3b59908e8ea2918c.gif[/img]

[h2]Delegate and relegate[/h2]
And finally, what’s better than giving your job to someone else and supervising them instead of doing the busy work yourself? You’ll be able to hire workers for your store, which can be especially handy when your store grows and you need more than two hands to manage everything! Just take a look at your potential workers! Just imagine them in your place and feel a sense of deep relief! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fa313a522a692840925deba51bf42414389d583e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

[h3]And that's not everything that will be available in the full version of [i]Clothing Store Simulator[/i]! [/h3]

We will cover more features, customization options, and clothes in our future manager trainings! 

If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 
[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

Have fun playing Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue, and don’t forget to wishlist the full game. Wait a minute… I think someone’s trying to steal a shirt! I need to grab him! See you next time!

notes.title: Store Manager Training #1
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, manager applicants! [/h1]

We all know why you are here—[b]you want to run your own Clothing Store and want it to succeed.[/b] Through these training sessions, you’ll learn how to crush your competition, attract customers, and, most importantly, run a successful clothing store! 

First off, you can listen to my lecture, but practice will ensure your future success! [b]Wishlist Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue right now, and then return! [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937710/Clothing_Store_Simulator_Prologue/

Is everybody finished? Let’s begi… Oh, and don’t forget to wishlist Clothing Store Simulator, so you’ll be ready to become the best clothing store manager when it becomes available! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

[b]All right, all right, now we can begin! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

[h2]Displaying the goods[/h2]
What’s the most important part of the clothing store? Anyone? Nobody? [i][b]THE CLOTHES[/b][/i], of course! If you want to make it here, you need customers to buy them. And they can’t buy them if you hide them around the store. It’s not an escape room; it’s a respectable business! Use hangers, shelves, and mannequins to display your stock and sell, Sell, [b]SELL[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/aed7070e89b828514539942543186e7647385539.gif[/img]

[h2]Hacking the system [/h2]
See that thing here? That’s your best friend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/27abf7228f30a2a46bac433d4197463e61063da4.png[/img]
Every time you wonder, ‘[i]Where do I get some new clothes?[/i]’, ‘[i]How can I order a flower to beautify the store?[/i]’ or ‘[i]How do I rip off my customers most efficiently?[/i]’ Just turn that bad boy on and click away!
You can order items for the store, adjust prices, sign brand deals—everything is at your fingertips. A store manager can be efficient, but a store manager who operates a computer is unstoppable.
So hack away… or whatever you kids do on these darn machines! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/2addba914161b74a1c8f2e76c56572c4e1303ab9.gif[/img]

[h2]Growing and showing[/h2]
If you’re sitting here, you probably have a tiny store and want to know how to use it efficiently before taking drastic measures like store enlargement. Let me tell you, I've worked with big and small ones, and the most important thing is personality!
Customize your store, rename it, put flowers everywhere, and order new mannequins! If the customers see you when they enter the store, you’ve won over their hearts! And when you feel like you’ve decorated it to the max, you can always expand it to bring even more customers in!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/a3f37b3fc13adbddaec050d171b2c1793384fb46.gif[/img]

[h2]Closing the Deal[/h2]
Not many brands want to work with you when you’re just starting, so your supply might be limited. People will still be interested in your clothes, but why stop there? More brands = more customers = more money!

[b]Remember that guy?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/589ff57ed2121d9975d94629a04525959550fae8.png[/img]

[h3][i]No, not him! This one![/i][/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/27abf7228f30a2a46bac433d4197463e61063da4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/cf928bc0b45719cc276c5203d6e7b746de9e5351.png[/img][/url]

Use your computer to sign brand deals to expand your store’s wardrobe! The bigger you get, the more brands you’ll be able to afford!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/3fcf7f06f953b7a914db264c7350d42199049011.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

[h3]That about covers it for our first lecture![/h3]

As a parting gift, I wanted to show you some pictures of the store that achieved great success after this lecture! [b]Here’s the store before the manager applied for our management course: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/4fe269e75136b15f1c137fc5ca80e184877a2d21.png[/img]

[b]And that’s the same store after the manager attended the course: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/5baf67dbf8cfa604ce819c28655e70f05ea612eb.png[/img]

See you at our next lecture, where we will go even deeper into the clothing store business! 
If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 
[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

Use it to control the prices, order new items, sign brand deals, and follow market trends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/bfc40f509294768f1056106f1765fd5468dbe0fe.gif[/img]

[h3]Customize your store. [/h3]
Rearrange furniture, order decorative elements, and expand the shopping zone and the warehouse, and move clothing items around to make the store of your dreams.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/2c72d42e74a7f02a69e8a981a97738c0e1ae4068.gif[/img]

[h3]Make brand deals. [/h3]
Find and sign brand deals to expand your store's clothing catalog, bringing new customers and more cash inflow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/354ee383f3c3297e5264b35e39beba527b2d4a28.gif[/img]

[h3]Follow the trends.[/h3]
Remove out-of-fashion clothes from the shopping floor and into the warehouse. Buy trending items to attract fashion lovers to your store. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/bf774f60a07e85bd781f96f2b787035b0fa73894.gif[/img]

[h3]Dress your customers.[/h3]
Dresses, shirts, pants, and more clothing items are available in-game!
